variants.subject: Why we changed how we cook
variants.body:
This change {{RANDOM | originated | began | started}} inside our DabbahWala kitchen.

{{RANDOM | Hi {{firstName|there}} | Hello {{firstName|there}} | Greetings, {{firstName|there}}}},

{{RANDOM | When we slowed things down and paid closer attention to how we cook, one thing became clear. | As we took a more deliberate approach and carefully observed our cooking methods, a key insight emerged. | Upon slowing down and focusing more intently on our cooking, we realized something important. }}

{{RANDOM | Cooking tasty food wasn’t the hard part. | The challenge wasn't in preparing delicious meals. | Creating flavorful dishes wasn't the difficult aspect. }}
{{RANDOM | Making it feel fresh and right every single day was. | Ensuring it felt consistently fresh and perfect daily was the real challenge. | The true difficulty lay in maintaining a sense of freshness and quality each and every day. }}

{{RANDOM | So we changed our process. | Therefore, we adjusted our approach. | Consequently, we modified our procedures. }}

{{RANDOM | Meals are now cooked only after orders come in. | We now prepare meals exclusively after receiving orders. | Dishes are cooked to order. }}
{{RANDOM | Vegetables are prepared fresh. | We use freshly prepared vegetables. | The vegetables are freshly prepared. }}
{{RANDOM | Food is cooked in smaller batches and delivered the same day. | We cook food in smaller quantities and deliver it the same day. | Our food is prepared in small batches and delivered on the same day. }}
{{RANDOM | Menus rotate so cooking never becomes repetitive or mechanical. | We rotate our menus to prevent cooking from becoming monotonous or automated. | The menus are rotated to ensure the cooking process remains fresh and engaging. }}

{{RANDOM | These changes weren’t about doing more. | These adjustments weren't about increasing output. | The purpose of these changes wasn't to produce more. }}
{{RANDOM | They were about doing things properly. | They were about ensuring things were done correctly. | It was about doing things the right way. }}

{{RANDOM | We wanted food to feel light, comforting, and familiar. | Our aim was for the food to be light, comforting, and familiar. | We desired the food to have a light, comforting, and familiar quality. }}
{{RANDOM | The kind of food you don’t get tired of. | The type of food you can always enjoy. | Food that you never grow weary of. }}

{{RANDOM | We’ll share more from the kitchen soon. | We will be sharing more updates from the kitchen shortly. | More news from the kitchen will be coming soon. }}

variants.body:
This is something people usually realize after a few meals.

{{RANDOM | Hi {{firstName|there}} | Hello {{firstName|there}} | Greetings, {{firstName|there}}}}

DabbahWala isn’t restaurant food.
And it’s not meant to be.

We cook the way we would at home.
That choice {{RANDOM | quietly changes everything | subtly alters everything | transforms everything in a quiet way}}.

It means using {{RANDOM | lighter, everyday oils | everyday, lighter oils | more lightweight, daily oils}}.
It means not relying on MSG or artificial enhancers.
Vegetables are prepared fresh.
Meals are cooked in small batches, not in bulk.

Restaurant food is designed for indulgence.
Our food is designed for everyday eating.

The kind you can come back to without feeling heavy.
The kind that {{RANDOM | fits into regular routines, not just special occasions | integrates into your daily life, not just for celebrations | works with your normal schedule, not only for special events}}.

We’re not trying to replace restaurants.
We’re trying to be the food you {{RANDOM | don’t have to think twice about | can enjoy without a second thought | can eat without hesitation}}.
